description: Lock-file naming derivation across custom manifest names: a custom base name yields <base>-patches.lock.json; explicitly setting the manifest back to the default composer.json yields the plain patches.lock.json; a manifest whose name contains an embedded dot keeps only the final-extension stripped base; a manifest with no extension at all is used verbatim as the base; and a manifest given with a directory prefix derives the name from its base name only. The output reports the resolved lock file name.
